explication: AI Engineering from Scratch is an interactive AI-learning curriculum and companion website. A learner chooses a route, opens a phase or lesson through the site or repository, reads Markdown, runs the lesson artifact, and records evidence. The curriculum spans mathematical and ML foundations, LLMs, agents, MCP, skills, multimodal systems, and capstones. Sampled code shows reusable prompt, pipeline, RAG, agent-sandbox, evaluation, and protocol artifacts. API internals and unsampled phase wiring are inferred only from names and README references.
